counterfactual_audits.hypothesis: AI-heavy projects possess an inherent winning advantage.
counterfactual_audits.finding: AI was present in 42% of winners versus 28% of non-winners. Given the high overall base rate (31%), AI is essentially table stakes rather than a standalone differentiator.

counterfactual_audits.hypothesis: The most technically complex codebase wins.
counterfactual_audits.counterexample_simplest_winner: Find Your Paradise won with only ~0 verified LOC.
counterfactual_audits.counterexample_complex_non_winner: Save Right did not win despite building ~535886 verified LOC.
counterfactual_audits.finding: Massive codebases do not guarantee victory. Simpler projects with focused workflows and polished presentations routinely triumph over sprawling engineering efforts.

counterfactual_audits.hypothesis: A pre-recorded video demo is mandatory to win.
counterfactual_audits.finding: 25/38 winning projects won without any pre-recorded video demo on Devpost, proving in-person live expo demonstrations and pitches were decisive.
